## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new flag should honor the required environment default so CI can configure exclusions.

## Changes
The pull request adds repeatable `--exclude GLOB` filtering, skip logging, documentation, and tests. This review read the tests without running them.

(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Take the exclusion default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, `skip.log` is still archived because the default is `[]`. This violates .agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11: “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment include files they intended to omit.
